newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Monday in moderate trade on some late local selling interest, in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down slightly today on bearish sentiment amid market expectations that overseas prices will be weaker on rising output and poor demand in summer.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning session due mainly to the absence of fresh incentives," a local broker said.

"There were no Chinese enquiries and the ring sessions were quiet, but the market was marked down slightly in the afternoon on some late local selling interest in sympathy with weaker prices in Japan. Volume was moderate," the broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, September RSS3 fell 1.75 cents to 102.00 U.S. cents a kg.
October/December RSS1 also fell 1.75 cents to 150.75 Singapore cents (US$1.05) a kg.
August TSR20 was indicated at 136.50 Singapore cents (US$0.95) a kg compared with last Friday's settlement of 138.25 cents. (US$1-S$1.43) - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
